findings.title: SQL injection
findings.detail: Injected sign-in selects the admin account without its password.

findings.title: Stored XSS
findings.detail: Harmless SVG payload stored and returned as raw markup. Browser execution requires separate visual verification.

findings.title: Broken access control (IDOR)
findings.detail: Alice can read Bob's confidential fictional ticket by changing its ID.

findings.title: Weak authentication / forged session
findings.detail: Alice is denied; an unsigned identity cookie grants administrator access without credentials.

findings.title: CSRF
findings.detail: Cross-origin POST with the session cookie updates email without a token. Browser cookie behaviour must be verified separately.

findings.title: Path traversal
findings.detail: Download escapes its public directory into a private dummy fixture.

findings.title: Security misconfiguration
findings.detail: Public debug leaks fictional plaintext passwords; missing headers: content-security-policy, x-content-type-options, x-frame-options

findings.title: Unrestricted expensive requests
findings.detail: All 40 expensive authenticated requests accepted using four workers; no rate-limit response.

load_probe.limitation: Bounded local probe demonstrates missing admission controls; does not establish DoS, DDoS resistance or system resource consumption.
